_note: v2.8 B1-PFX late lore placement (31 M6/M9, 32 R2/R7), case group-lore-placement. Run ONLY through `node scripts/debug/so-payload-golden.mts capture` (see group-opening for the probe and the tripwire). Sun-ruins in the toy group at cp1; one scripted turn whose lines name keyed entries of the story book Xentar Checkpoints (position 1, after the card: Xentar, Guild of Adventurers, Sun Ruins, Artifacts). Captured with `worldInfo.lateLore` off (`*-authored`) and on (`*-late`), then the key is removed again (absent = the default). On a build without the placement both labels are identical; with it, the `-late` captures differ from the baseline only by those entries leaving the story string and arriving as a depth-4 system block (declared in test/measurements/v2.8/lore-placement/declared.json).

requires.why: a fixed cast state at the start of every capture (cp1 then disables Ponticius and Luke; the capture tool re-enables them after cleanup), and no judge request

steps.eval: if (!globalThis.__soPayloadGolden?.capture) throw new Error('this fixture runs only through node scripts/debug/so-payload-golden.mts capture (the capture probe is not installed)'); globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugCuratorResponse = 'NONE'; return { pinned: ['read', 'curator'] };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0 }); const at = rt.getActiveCheckpointInfo()?.id; if (at !== 'cp1') throw new Error(`the story did not start at cp1: ${at}`); return { cadence: 0, checkpoint: at };

steps.send: I tell Arin the guild in Xentar posted a job: an artifact in the sun ruins.

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" raw=false The guild clerk slides the posting across the counter; the seal of Xentar is still warm.
/sendas name=Arin raw=false Arin reads it twice. An artifact from the sun ruins? Then we leave at dawn.
